facts.fact: National Treasury and the SARB invited interested parties to submit written comments by 30 September 2026 on the draft Crypto Assets Manual for cross-border activities, to complement the draft Capital Flow Management Regulations.
facts.system: Draft Crypto Assets Manual for cross-border activities

facts.fact: National Treasury published the draft Capital Flow Management Regulations for public comment on 17 April 2026, and the two bodies state that comments received are being considered.
